entries.name: 386DX
entries.author: seajaysec
entries.description: A karaoke robot with a band: it sings songs from karaoke and MIDI files, or lines you type, to the notes you play. Its face is the voice. Keys, bass and drums play along, with a step sequencer and sixteen punch-in effects.

entries.name: 3IS
entries.author: obbymaul-mp3
entries.description: Chord-instrument firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, after ChoralRoot FM-1 and Felucca (GPL-3.0)

entries.name: 5-LAB
entries.author: oMauNaProducer
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.author: superposition
entries.description: NAIWAN 91 — city pop and coastal firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: A22
entries.author: A22
entries.description: An FM workstation: twelve engines (FM, electric piano, analog, wavetable, drums, 8-bit chip and more) with eight algorithms each, eight effects, a four-track tape with knob automation, a mixer, sequencers and colour vector graphics. Derived from h1 by Jake Handy.

entries.name: AAAVEGETAL
entries.author: capitanplaneta80-create
entries.description: VEGETAL: la familia vegetal (filotaxis, sistemas L, tropismos, raíces) como firmware para el M-VAVE FM-1 (sobre Felucca)

entries.name: abrams
entries.author: drbscl
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: ABYSS
entries.author: Tentacle
entries.description: An experimental noise synth inspired by the APTBS x Death By Audio Synthesizer: three cross-modulating oscillators (FM, ring, sync, chaos), six noise types, a resonant filter, six drives, two PT2399-style feedback delays. Up to 4 voices, MIDI clock sync, TRS and USB MIDI, 14 sounds, 10 user slots.

entries.name: Adrift
entries.author: Romain Guy
entries.description: Adrift transforms the M-VAVE FM-1 into a 16-voice, 6-part Bucket-Brigade Resonator synthesizer, capable of plucked guitars, bowed cellos, buzzing sitars, granular clouds, hands-free drones, and massive unison leads.

entries.name: AEther
entries.author: twaroshinto
entries.description: Custom open source M-Vave FM1 firmware for spectral based synthesizer (inspired by paul stretch).

entries.name: AETHER FM1
entries.author: GR!MM
entries.description: Dark ambient, dungeon synth and deathdream firmware: 4 tracks, 7 sound sources, real recorded choirs, tracks that play by themselves, and long tape, granular and reverb effects.

entries.name: AGTDECK
entries.author: Kevin Elliott
entries.description: A control surface for coding agents, not an instrument: the keys and screen show which of your Claude Code, Codex or other command-line agents are working, finished or waiting on you, and the buttons approve, deny, interrupt and prompt them. It needs its daemon on the computer.

entries.name: AISLING
entries.author: CU_STE
entries.description: Irish ambient music that plays itself for ever: harps, flute and drone. Eight pieces to steer, or play along on its keys, a keyboard or a DAW. Now an app on your iPhone too, no FM-1 needed. Its visualiser paints the music as an Irish landscape.

entries.name: AISLING FX-1
entries.author: CU_STE
entries.description: Guitar effects from an FM-1. A guitar, or any sound a computer plays, goes in over USB and comes out of its socket through AISLING's live effects: reverb, shimmer, echo, phaser, drive, crush and more, held by key or CC. Knobs set the filter, sends and dry.

entries.name: alarusse
entries.author: etopotemkin
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: ALTER
entries.author: Forban5929
entries.description: ALTER turns the FM-1 into a live euclidean groove machine for industrial techno: 3 rhythm circles, 7 percussive engines, dice and CHAOS to redraw a scene, Turing loops, a mixer per circle, master filter, delay and reverb, 48 scenes and a companion page in the browser.

entries.name: AMB-1
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: A generative ambient machine after Music for Airports: it plays itself from the start, breathing voices, bells on tape loops of unequal length, a gliding bass. You do not perform it, you tend it.

entries.name: AMB-1-Evolved
entries.author: kidbee85-beep
entries.description: Generative Ambient-Firmware für den M-VAVE FM-1: AMB-1-Bedienung, 64 Sounds, 32 Themen und Bunkai-Wolf-A1-Design. GPL-3.0-only.

entries.name: amb-pond
entries.author: superxor
entries.description: A generative garden pond. Switch it on and it plays itself: breathing voices, water drops, a gliding bass and quiet drips, with echo and reverb. Nine pieces, from a quiet pond to rain and thunder. Pick a piece and a scale, take notes out or put them back, and let it grow.

entries.name: ambwave
entries.author: mentalcells
entries.description: Ambient firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, derived from Felucca.

entries.name: Amenity
entries.author: Presethead
entries.description: A live jungle tool built around classic breaks (Amen, Apache, Think) and your own. Hold white keys for rolls, builds, echo and Akai-style metallic stretch, play hits on the black keys, and shape the break with variation, warp, ringing feedback, lo-fi, EQ, saturation and compression.

entries.name: ANDROMEDA
entries.author: Polaris Sound Lab
entries.description: Ambient music that writes itself. Choose one of 13 moods and ALIGN builds a whole 4-track piece, always in key; AUTO keeps it growing from your own notes. A three-head SPACE TAPE echo with spring, SKY macros, and visions drawn live from the sound: cymatics, harmonograph, attractor and orrery.

entries.name: anvilxox
entries.author: marcusnewmantraining
entries.description: X0X: groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 (909, 808, two 303s with TB-3PO, breakbeat generator, song mode). A fork of Felucca.

entries.name: april-os
entries.author: beashoko
entries.description: FM-1 firmware Felucca fork that focuses on sampling

entries.name: Araminta
entries.author: Wulgaren
entries.description: Synthesizer firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1. A Felucca 1.5.1 fork with free take, punch-ins, DRUM-X, 13 engines, and a chainable effects list.

entries.name: Arctic Scream
entries.author: PolarPatch
entries.description: Long dark screaming ambient from the frozen Arctic. A living feedback loop creeps out of the cold and grows into a howl, ice sings when struck, wind drifts over the tundra. Four tracks, ten sound sources, endless reverb and shimmer. Let it play whole pieces by itself through the eight Sami seasons.

entries.name: Arcturus S6
entries.author: Zeptosecond DSP
entries.description: An experimental, self-playing wavetable instrument for generative, evolving soundscapes. Four PPG-style oscillators, Serge-style function generators, sample-and-holds and logic, patched through mod and gate matrices. 12 bit, 22kHz, green phosphor CRT, Fairlight-style pages.

entries.name: Argo
entries.author: echoe
entries.description: An LLM-written expansion of Felucca with eight patterns per track, pattern chaining (up to 512 steps/pattern), per-step patch switching, multiple new chord modes, generative arpeggiator, new synth engines LEAD and SH-DRUM, borrowed engines SWARM, FM-TONE, and WAVETONE from Mini-Tone, new effects…

entries.name: ARP WAV 09
entries.author: Wav.09.02
entries.description: Arp Wav 09 is a minimalist and instinctive FirmWare. I disabled all the Fm-1’s keys. Only the Home key stays active. Everything is played with knobs. Experiment with the three voices. No sound preset. You play with the Fm-1's signal in real time. Three voices. ARP / WAV / A09.

entries.name: ARTIHIVE
entries.author: KHAV
entries.description: Eight-voice experimental drone and polyphonic FM synthesizer with four interacting pairs, envelopes, legato glide, hyper LFO, stereo motion, dual modulated delay and a 1-16 step arpeggiator and sequencer. Artistically inspired by SOMA LYRA-8; independently developed.

entries.name: ASS-ID
entries.author: altessproduction
entries.description: The ATEK303 acid groovebox plus a drum track on the same clock: eight synthesized TR-808/909/707 voices, no samples, a seeded 64-step generator with mutations and LOCK for both tracks, an 8x16 drum matrix, swing, three kits, drive, chorus, delay, reverb and eight factory presets.

entries.name: Astra
entries.author: Michael Perry
entries.description: Your birth chart as an FM synth: the FM-1 works out the planets itself, casts your chart, and the aspects between today's sky and your chart wire ten FM operators, one per planet. Four voices, a horoscope you can read on the screen, a sky you can run at five years a second, chorus, echo, reverb…

entries.name: ATEK303
entries.author: Animatek
entries.description: A TB-303 style acid synth with its own pattern generator: press PLAY and a line plays. Generate, mutate and undo patterns up to 64 steps, edit steps in a piano roll, add drive, chorus, synced delay and plate reverb. The ATEK303 engine from VCV Rack with 14 oscillators and its fine tuning, 12…

entries.name: Atl-Atl: The Atltuner
entries.author: Jason Scheirer
entries.description: A USB audio interface and autotuner for the M-VAVE FM-1. Play computer audio into it, hold a key to tune it, and use the three-second sampler, tempo, ARP mask and latch.

entries.name: AUDILUNE
entries.author: AUDILUNE
entries.description: A live groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: aurora-fm1
entries.author: andrewdamelio
entries.description: AURORA — ambient-machine custom firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1. Plays itself: drifting pads, bells and wind in a huge reverb. Runs on the hardware and in the browser.

entries.name: B1
entries.author: Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks)
entries.description: B1 turns the M-VAVE FM1 into a compact drawbar rock organ with 91 shared tonewheels, nine drawbars per registration, percussion, Leslie, B3/ROCK tones, MIDI and expressive live controls.

entries.name: B3 ORGAN
entries.author: R-Jeb
entries.description: A B3 tonewheel organ computed from setBfree's own data: 91 wheels, drawbars for three manuals, key click, vibrato and chorus, percussion, overdrive, reverb, a Leslie and an output equalizer. All 110 setBfree programs, 16 of your own, and a web editor that reads and stores the FM-1's sound.

entries.name: badboy
entries.author: benna1985
entries.description: Custom Jungle style firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: badgear-os
entries.author: alibros
entries.description: Bad Gear OS: meme fan firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, built on Felucca (GPL-3.0)

entries.name: baile-fm1
entries.author: arrastao
entries.description: BAILE by Mulú — Brazilian rhythm kits for M-VAVE FM-1. Experimental firmware and simulator.

entries.name: baile-fm1
entries.author: saulofilho
entries.description: BAILE é um firmware livre para o M-VAVE FM-1 feito para funk brasileiro: tamborzão, Volt Mix, funk 150, mandelão, brega funk e montagem. É um tracker: cada linha é um passo, cada coluna uma faixa, e a música desce a tela. Seis faixas, um sequenciador por passos, patterns encadeados numa música, 64 efeitos ao vivo, tabelas, groove por passo...

entries.name: Bass Something 2
entries.author: John Brown
entries.description: A Bass Station II style mono synth with arp and sequencer, plus a Drumtraks-inspired drum machine, an RMI Electra-piano style electric piano, a Hammond B-3 style tonewheel organ with its Leslie, and an RE-201 style tape echo and spring reverb. Motion recorder, 128 patches and SysEx dumps.

entries.name: bb-bob-firmware
entries.author: TexasRADIO
entries.description: Big Beat Studio BB-BOB firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: BB1
entries.author: Big Beat Studio
entries.description: Two drum machines, sampled classics, a synthesised 808 and Dillo acid bass—our armadillo with the low end. Capture what just happened, recall song FX, edit live and send the mix over USB.

entries.description: Groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, based on Felucca

entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.description: BE HERE NOW: a sarod-inspired firmware for the M-VAV FM-1 that teaches you what you play

entries.description: Karplus Strong engine with a transposable Turing Machine firmware for the FM1

entries.description: Stylus-style beat maker firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 after the Stylophone BEAT

entries.name: BEETLE
entries.author: Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks)
entries.description: BEETLE transforms the FM-1 into a powerful 6-channel music workstation. Create beats, design sounds with retro-inspired synth engines, sequence entire songs, and perform with live effects. A complete pocket-sized tracker, drum machine, and synthesizer. Built for creativity, born out of passion.

entries.name: BEETLE BLUE
entries.author: Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks)
entries.description: BEETLE BLUE turns your M-VAVE FM1 into a six-lane drum tracker. Build beats with BEETLE and MONOLITH kits, design custom drums, arrange songs, and perform setlists with Live Mode and hands-on effects.

entries.author: CallieSchmallie
entries.description: Stinky

entries.name: Beiwagen
entries.author: Kabelmaier
entries.description: A USB sidecar for the OP-1 Field: the OP-1 streams its four tape tracks to the FM-1, the FM-1 sends a chosen track back as the OP-1's USB input to record, and its keys play the OP-1 over USB-MIDI.

entries.name: BENTFM
entries.author: zederoteme
entries.description: An MPL-2.0 base and template for M-VAVE FM-1 firmware, on felucca-bsp: platform, host simulator, browser emulator, Bluetooth MIDI, WiFi, USB audio

entries.name: Berlinan
entries.author: Jiří Píša
entries.description: A generative Berlin School MIDI sequencer: a small ensemble of voices that repeat, phase against each other on loops of unequal length and earn their mutations over time. The FM-1 makes no sound with it: each voice goes out over USB on its own MIDI channel to your synths, as Berlinan for macOS…

entries.name: bgirl-fm1
entries.author: track-forge
entries.description: an electro fm1 firmware

entries.name: Bigorna

entries.description: Rhythmic noise, power noise, industrial and IDM after the Elektron Digitone II: six tracks, four machines (4-OP, DRUM, WAVY, HIVE), parameter locks on a 16-step sequencer, a looper, send effects and USB audio.

entries.description: Android MIDI/BLE companion panel for blackbox-fm1 custom Blackbox firmware

entries.description: Experimental Felucca synthesizer firmware port for the M-VAVE ANN Blackbox, with guarded USB development tools

entries.name: BLAZE
entries.author: STMLYZ
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: Blop
entries.author: Obsimo
entries.description: Explore sound with your Blop: one-finger chords from 38 grids, chord rhythms, a bass with its own riffs and a few discreet drums with sidechain, while a little creature swims to your chords in an aquarium on the screen. Chords and bass go out as MIDI over USB.

entries.name: bluehare
entries.author: TristanoSuriani
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1 with Tracker interface based on Felucca

entries.name: Blues Box
entries.author: Brian Provost
entries.description: Live 3-piece blues & funk backing band for the FM-1. Features 19 grooves, 25 lead voices with Easy Lead scale-lock, 5-level Band Heat escalation, style-matched intros/outros, Chocolate footswitch control, and an animated 8-bit stage with a chord-flashing Tweed amp.

entries.name: Bluetooth-control-multi-firmware-m-vave-fm1-fm1-emu
entries.author: Koolkatze
entries.description: Emulator for the M-VAVE FM-1 pocket synth: runs its firmwares unchanged in the browser and in android, uses the device to output midi Bluetooth or usb c to the phone, bigger screen, better resolution, enabling every firmware without flashing.

entries.name: bocjuhn
entries.author: ryuji kanagawa
entries.description: A six-track instrument for sound exploration and live layering. Eight engines span FM, acid bass, textures and hybrid drums. Shape sounds with granular processing, filters and effects; record free loops, build sequences, add automatic accompaniment and morph between snapshots. Based on Tonitor.

entries.name: bonbloop
entries.author: henribon
entries.description: BONBLOOP: SLOOP + a SYNTH MODE (3 oscillators, wavetables, reverse, FX) for the M-VAVE FM-1. Install from the browser.

entries.name: bongo-cat-studio
entries.author: ImpossibleKnot
entries.description: Bongo Cat’s Tiny Studio by Impossible Knot. Four cats, thirteen synth engines and zero rent contributions. Playable M-VAVE FM-1 firmware built on Felucca.

entries.name: boopbox
entries.author: Josh-McFarlin
entries.description: A live groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: BOP-1
entries.author: devrvega
entries.description: BOP-1 for M-Vave FM-1

entries.name: BOURDON
entries.author: Kevin Sint
entries.description: A drone instrument for the FM-1. Three voices, each with a style, a free frequency and a link to the voice before it. Twelve LFOs with steps and loops, three disruptors (noise, chop, ring), and a delay, reverb and compressor after the voices.

entries.name: braindancer
entries.author: NorfolkHacker
entries.description: ACID FM: IDM / braindance firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 (a fork of JIANT FM)

entries.name: brutal-fm
entries.author: hiroikezawa
entries.description: BRUTAL FM: experimental FM synth firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 (Felucca-based)

entries.name: Bubba Machine
entries.author: Erbubar23
entries.description: A six-track groovebox written from scratch: TR drums from Plaits' 808 and 909 models, a sampler with a 16-slice slicer, a bass and three free tracks (analog, 6-op FM, 303 acid), scenes and fills, all at 44.1 kHz.

entries.name: bump-it
entries.author: epidex
entries.description: Bump It: custom FM-1 firmware, all of SLOOP 2.8.5 with a purple theme, frequency-coloured oscilloscope, BUMP IT boot screen and screen brightness (no Bluetooth)

entries.name: Bunker Evolved
entries.author: Kid Bunka
entries.description: Generative ambient: four editable layers from 64 sound recipes, 24 worlds, 24 motifs and 32 scales. GROW varies the phrases, seven EVOLVE processes change them over time. Felucca's sound pages stay. Built on Felucca 1.6.1.

entries.name: Burger Studio FM-1
entries.author: Maker Hip (Hippie Maker)
entries.description: Sampling-first firmware built on Felucca 1.8.2. A SAMPLE row on HOME opens EDIT SAMPLE to trim and slice the three user slots, and one sample can span two or three slots, up to about 84 seconds. Use it alone or with the Burger Studio app for Android, which sends samples over USB.

entries.name: Bytemania
entries.author: lloyd (llozd)
entries.description: A bytebeat synth: play one-line formulas, tweak them with the knobs, and write your own, with a random button in the formula creator that is really fun. A beta, built on Dinghy.

entries.name: canon-4
entries.author: davidpryan
entries.description: M-VAVE FM-1 firmware: one phrase, four playheads: a canon

entries.name: CansuBox
entries.author: tgorkems
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: CansuLeLe
entries.author: tgorkems
entries.description: Six-track groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1: 14 synth and drum engines, a 64-step sequencer, patterns and songs, live performance, and a browser editor. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: Caravel
entries.author: BonszaiMusic
entries.description: Caravel 1.1 for the M-VAVE FM-1: six synthesis engines (ANALOG, PHYS, SEM, HADES, DRONE, ENSEMBLE) across four tracks. Shape and perform with BUILD/PLAY, HARMONY, MIDI CAPTURE loops, STASIS, RANDOM, JOURNEY and ELASTIC. Explore the browser emulator and Caravel Academy.

entries.name: cardbuddy
entries.author: konsumer
entries.description: fm1buddy for the M5 Cardputer: FM-1 firmware swapping, backup, recovery

entries.name: cardputer-fm1-flasher
entries.author: nasonliu
entries.description: Standalone M-VAVE FM-1 firmware flasher & Wi-Fi Firmware Hub client for M5Stack Cardputer ADV (supports UC25HQ80 0xB36014 & P25Q80H 0x856014)

entries.name: Carnac OS
entries.author: OrbVorgis
entries.description: CARNAC OS is a dual-timbral wavetable synth inspired by neolithic monuments and forgotten rituals. Built for deep sound design and immediate control, with a MAQ 16/3-style sequencer and a J6-style chord arp. The PCM waves need a separate installer: get it from my GitHub page.

entries.name: Castletunia
entries.author: Brian Provost
entries.description: 16-bit JRPG boss fights as a musical instrument. Play a riff on the keyboard and your three-hero party—Fighter, Cleric, and Sorceress—weaves it into a live fantasy battle soundtrack across nine pixel-art realms, while bosses wind up drum-roll counter-attacks that curse your beat, harmony, and…

entries.name: Chipbox
entries.author: pbarilla
entries.description: A ultra-refined Chiptune music editor, featuring over 35 classic chips such as NES, Gameboy, heck even the Sunsoft 5B! Pages with their own meter, tempo and glide, so waltzes and 7/8 grooves are easy. Gimmick fans rejoice!

entries.name: CHOPPAH
entries.author: Laurens Profittlich
entries.description: An Amen break chopper for the FM-1: eight classic breaks cut into 16 slices on the white keys, hold a key to loop it. Black keys are momentary pads for rolls, reverse, freeze, tape stop, gate, filter and dub throws. A generator rearranges the break live, with a four-slot FX chain and a DJ filter.

entries.name: ChoralRoot
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: A Telepathic Orchid-style chord instrument: one hand plays roots, the other shapes chords; voicings, performance modes, bass and a looper.

entries.name: ChoralRootj-6
entries.author: EremanSim
entries.description: Port of Choral Root to MWave FM1 but with Roland j6 chord set

entries.name: CHORD RUN
entries.author: swtdr34mz (based on Blop by Obsimo)
entries.description: One-finger chord player: a song's chords on the black keys, a scale-matched melody on the white keys (ASSIST lights the good notes). 17 songs, each with its own sounds and drums; thirteen drum styles; a 4-bar looper; a runner that runs while you play, with missions and characters to unlock.

entries.name: Chrome-Boy-Studio-Portable
entries.author: ColdChrome
entries.description: Chrome Boy Studio Portable is playful, chaotic custom firmware for the M-VAVE FM1. Spin the ALGORITHM knob for instant patterns, pull random progressions, and play it in your browser before installing it on your FM1. Still experimental: bug fixes, quality-of-life features, better export and more MIDI options are on the way.

entries.name: CINCO
entries.author: mrjoshida
entries.description: Cinco Identity Generator 2.5 (Celery Man) custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: Clair Piano
entries.author: Simon Tokumine
entries.description: A tap-played modern Pianola for the FM-1. Pick from 87 classic piano rolls and tap any key to perform every phrase at your own rhythm and touch — or hit PLAY and punch in live Pocket-Operator-style tempo, repeat, and in-key pianist flourish FX on the keys. Toggle off anytime for Basic Piano.

entries.name: CLATTER Pocket
entries.author: allmyfriendsaresynths
entries.description: A generative drum machine on the LXR sound engine. Seven voices, kits grown from a seed in 16 characters, a 64-step sequencer with conditions and per-step pitch, patterns generated and mutated in 11 styles, MIDI notes and clock in, and nine named projects.

entries.name: Clavioline
entries.author: MammothCheese
entries.description: Turns the FM-1 into the 1947 Clavioline, an early electronic analog synthesizer. Faithfully rebuilt from the original circuit diagrams with distinctive tone-shaping stops, vibrato, knee-lever expression and vintage electronic sounds.

entries.name: cleansweep
entries.author: ocean
entries.description: A data cleanup utility firmware for the FM-1. No sound.

entries.name: Clipper
entries.author: isod89
entries.description: A deep synth grown out of SLOOP: 23 engines and 407 sounds, from HYBRID (three oscillators, two filters, a mod matrix) to six-operator FM, wavetables, wave sequencing, a Juno and physical models; arp, step sequencer, MPE and a web editor for every parameter.

entries.name: clipper-fm1-RAIN
entries.author: RainViert
entries.description: Clipper: an experimental synthesizer firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 (from SLOOP, based on Felucca)

entries.name: clipper_for_EWI
entries.author: deepblue0369
entries.description: Clipper for EWI: Experimental firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 wind synthesizer (developed by SLOOP, based on Felucca)

entries.name: COLLAPSE
entries.author: swtdr34mz
entries.description: A physics drum machine inspired by Anukari: six instruments that are masses on springs (drum heads, snare wires, a cymbal plate, a bouncing ball, a resonator, a string), shaking each other, bouncing and drifting off the grid. MASS and CHAOS, per-instrument FM/GRAIN/FILTER, PITCH as time dilation…

entries.name: compas-firmware
entries.author: TexasRADIO
entries.description: Public Compás firmware releases

entries.name: CONDUCTOR
entries.author: MammothCheese
entries.description: A pocket symphony orchestra groovebox with strings, woodwinds, brass and percussion. Compose in piano roll or musical notation, conduct individual sections with articulations, dynamics and expression curves, and arrange patterns into complete pieces.

entries.name: COQUÍ
entries.author: saulofilho
entries.description: Latin and Caribbean groovebox: synthesized congas, bongos, timbales, guiro and cowbell, 14 grooves from salsa and bomba to dembow, tumbao and montuno lines over the chord you hold, generative parts in the clave, and effect scenes from a backyard to a dub.

entries.name: coracle

entries.description: forking dinghy - playing around with mistral and my FM-1

entries.name: CoralFlower
entries.author: FicusFicusov
entries.description: Chords after the Orchid, with controls made for the FM-1: one key plays a chord with a bass note. Also 27 scales, an arpeggiator, a sequencer with drums and a song mode, and a pixel flower that grows as you play.

entries.name: cortex

entries.description: CORTEX: generative FM firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, with a video synth, MIDI-file songs and a browser simulator

entries.description: CRATE: an original slice/performance sampler firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 (JieLi AC791N), built on the Felucca HAL. GPL-3.0-only.

entries.description: Crawl: dark generative ambient firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: CS-1
entries.author: twochannels
entries.description: A Yamaha CS-80 in spirit: eight voices of two channels, high- and low-pass filters in series, ring modulator, the touch response and 22 tones from the owner's manual. A sound module played over MIDI.

entries.name: CTL-1
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: A MIDI controller: notes in any scale with its chords on the black keys, four banks of knobs, an arpeggiator and Euclidean drums, with General MIDI sounds of its own when nothing is connected.

entries.name: CULTBOX
entries.author: beatcult
entries.description: A three-channel groovebox: a Polivoks-style duophonic synth (PLVKS), an Elka-style sample drum machine with a step sequencer, and a dub siren, with BBD echoes, per-channel character effects, arp, scales and a mixer with panning.

entries.name: cumbia
entries.author: saboraldea
entries.description: a cumbia groovebox for the m vave fm1

entries.name: cursed os
entries.author: cursedsound
entries.description: An Elektron-style six-track groovebox for the FM-1, with Elektron Syntakt support. One-press quick-start loops, generators for acid lines, dub chords, held atmospheres and modular bleeps, trig conditions and locks, a DJ filter and FX pad, and the keys set the song's key. Built on JIANT FM.

entries.name: Cut-A-Dor
entries.author: Kid Bunka
entries.description: A beat dojo for scratch DJs and beatmakers: boom bap, lo-fi and breaks from 16 rhythm families with swing and fills, an eight-lane 32-step sequencer, punch-in effects you record bar by bar, a bass voice. Sound banks and editor in the browser.

entries.name: cyberdeck-fm1
entries.author: devan78
entries.description: Cyberpunk firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: cyma-1
entries.author: TEG-Lizard-Man
entries.description: CYMA-1 by Team EG & Lizard_Man

entries.name: d-fiddy
entries.author: lewhomusic
entries.description: A D-50 style LA synthesizer firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 (bring your own ROMs; not affiliated with Roland)

entries.name: dabbl8
entries.author: grant-vine
entries.description: Dabbl8 is an open-source firmware project for the M-VAVE FM-1, based on Felucca, aiming to deliver eight-track sequencing, multi-engine synthesis and expressive live performance.

entries.name: DABKE
entries.author: STUDIOMORPHIK
entries.description: An Arabic wedding keyboard. Maqam scales with quarter tones on any note, dabke and shaabi rhythms, mijwiz, zurna, oud and qanun voices, a drone, eight tracks with loops and steps. Lean on a key and the note bends. An Akai MIDImix works as its mixer.

entries.name: Dark Funk Durcal Synt
entries.author: Polaris Sound Lab
entries.description: Dark funk on the FM-1. Pick two of 15 styles and RITUAL summons a whole 4-track song in one press, always in key: acid lines, chopped breaks, warped funk. Mutes, stutter, build and drop for live sets, NEXT suggests your next phrase, a tape echo, and an eye on screen that burns with the music.

entries.name: DARK-1
entries.author: Polystellarflow
entries.description: Dark-music firmware for the FM-1: 21 genres, 210 pieces, dark techno to dark ambient and darkwave. Wander evolves it on its own. Arp, Dice, step editor, new visuals, simpler settings, bigger text. Works on older and newer FM-1s (both flash chips).

entries.name: Daurade
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: Grooves in chrome: filtered, pumping, robotic. Press PLAY and Daurade plays a filtered loop that opens over sixteen bars, a mix that pumps on every kick, a robot voice singing the hook and crisp drums. Ten styles; steer it with four knobs, drop it, set off a solo or play the lead yourself.

entries.name: DAYV-X
entries.author: Repoman
entries.description: A four-part groovebox for hazy, worn-tape music: DRIFT, a synth whose pitch never sits still, AGE, a tape stage with wow, flutter and hiss on the whole mix, a dusty synthesised drum kit with a GRIT control, FM bells and acid basses. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: DEEP FIELD
entries.author: Kyle McCann
entries.description: A drone synth with velocity-sensitive keys. Press a key and a voice plays until you stop it: eight voices, thirteen sounds. Motion modes move them in your scale: single notes, chords, chord progressions, arpeggios. Chorus, delay and reverb with freeze. A mixer for drone, lead and effects.

entries.name: DekBass-FM1
entries.author: g0rst
entries.description: FM DekBass Station Firmware for FM1

entries.name: Del Rio
entries.author: Jess Del Rio
entries.description: A rhythm box of ceremony percussion: djembe, cajon, udu, clapsticks, maracas and triangle on the black keys, a step sequencer on the white keys. The berimbau and the capoeira's bateria have their own page. A tanpura and a shruti box sound alone or under the rhythm.

entries.name: Demake
entries.author: Sequencist
entries.description: An ambient lofi machine on 64 of its author's own pedal recordings: three synths, each with a piano roll, eight patterns, its own reverb, delay or tape echo and motion; huge shared reverbs, colour and old media over the whole mix; a chord machine and an arpeggiator, sixteen scenes, a song mode.

entries.name: DFD ACID ENGINE
entries.author: Polaris Sound Lab
entries.description: Acid and dirty electro for the FM-1. One squelching voice (acid saw or square, a wall of detuned saws, fidget) plays epic 16-step riffs from the web generator: 16 styles, 19 sounds, GENERATE, MUTATE, DNA lock and a DIRTY page with filth, pump and zap. Same patterns as the web and plug-in.

entries.name: dinghy
entries.author: fabiomassimopasquazzi
entries.description: The smallest firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 to build your own on: the plumbing done and documented (updates, USB rescue, USB-MIDI, USB audio, panel, screen, settings), a sine on top.

entries.name: Dinghy
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: Your base for your own FM-1 or SMK-37 firmware: everything under it done and documented (updates, USB rescue, MIDI over USB and the TRS jack with clock, USB audio, keys, screen, flash storage, an update screen), a 4-voice sine on top, tests and a CI that releases with attestation. Fork it, replace the sine.

entries.name: dinghy-agentic
entries.author: marksweiss
entries.description: An agentic toolkit for building synth firmwares for the M-VAVE FM-1 with Claude Code: a coordinator, 12 agents, 16 skills, reusable synth modules, two targets (Dinghy, M-VAVE FM1 Open). Fork of Dinghy.

entries.description: The smallest firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 to build your own on: the plumbing done and documented (updates, USB rescue, USB-MIDI, USB audio, panel, screen, settings), a sine on top.

entries.description: Live synthesizer firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, based on Sloop 2.7: A/B layers and split, dry factory patches and cosmic dog visuals.

entries.description: Fm1 firmware

entries.description: Doom for M-VAVE FM-1 and SMK-37 Pro / Elite, with a browser firmware builder and installer.

entries.name: Double-Rainbow

entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1 designed for the YA crowd

entries.name: DP3OYB
entries.author: DP3OYB
entries.description: A 6-track performance groovebox enhanced from Felucca. Adds 2 LFOs with sequencer trigs, retriggering envelopes, mixer and track sequencing views with quick-access controls, multi-track note hold, LED-assisted chord-mode, and a redesigned UI optimized for live use.

entries.name: drelva-vave
entries.author: mordf0kas
entries.description: Drelva Vave - custom firmware + emulator for the M-Vave FM-1 (GPL-3.0)

entries.name: DRIFT
entries.author: FBNFRTG
entries.description: An ambient instrument for live sessions: warm synths, spacious pads and delicate plucks over a generative Euclidean sequencer on one track, with delays and reverbs from spring to shimmer. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: drift-fm1
entries.author: I-am-MaxPower
entries.description: A Omnichord drone firmware for the FM-1

entries.name: Drumlab
entries.author: pbarilla
entries.description: Microtonic, for the FM-1! Roll the dice for a kit, build one from scratch, or bring in your Microtonic presets and patterns. Share kits and patterns as files, and send it all to your Teenage Engineering PO-32! Built on Chipbox!

entries.name: Drumtonic
entries.author: Federico Ciapi
entries.description: A drum machine for the FM-1: ten synthesized drum channels, 32 patterns of up to 64 steps with p-locks, conditions, micro timing and ratchets, free recording with QUANT, beat repeat, 8 LFOs per pattern, reverb, tape delay and a master compressor. No samples, no computer needed.

entries.name: DUB-1
entries.author: sbegueria
entries.description: A generative dub techno machine that plays itself from the moment it is on: chord stabs into a tape echo, FM pings, a sub bass on five grooves, a ducking kick, crackle, and an eight-bar arrangement with breaks and fills.

entries.name: DUB-BOX
entries.author: altessproduction
entries.description: A dub station for the M-VAVE FM-1: the USB/BT audio router with sloop-DUB's dub modules on top — a dub siren, a tape echo, a bipolar DJ filter and a four-band isolator, each page's four settings on K1-K4, the black keys as the live performance: the eighth turns the dub on and off, the ninth and…

entries.name: dubengine
entries.author: marwanfarha
entries.description: Custom Firmware for M Vave FM1

entries.name: DUELL
entries.author: OSCILL/R
entries.description: A MULTIMORPHING bitimbral synth: two complete parts, three ways to play them together, and a morph that glides between two versions of every sound. Ten engines with wavetables, twin filters, effects and a mod matrix. Macros and MIDI presets for Circuit Tracks and MPC/Force. Velocity, aftertouch.

entries.name: DUELL-TIDE
entries.author: pssdrnk-cmyk
entries.description: TIDE for FM-1: a morph that plays and evolves by itself. Firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, built on DUELL (OSCILL/R) and Felucca (Hügelton Instruments), GPL-3.0.

entries.name: dumbmidi
entries.author: konsumer
entries.description: A really nice MIDI controller firmware for the M-VAVE SMK-37 and FM-1: big chord display, screen mapping, BLE/USB MIDI, arp, chord memory, scale, splits.

entries.name: Dungeon Tracker
entries.author: Bourbon Weather
entries.description: Four Track Groovebox with a dungeon crawler cooked into the home screen for the visualizer. Create your party from 8 heroes, store up to 6 sequences then string them together in Song mode!

entries.description: An eight-part multitimbral DX7 module. Every part has its own MIDI channel and up to eight layered DX7 voices, with key splits, velocity windows and 64 scenes. A master filter, shared reverb and delay, DX7 ROM import and a web configurator. Played and controlled over MIDI.

entries.description: A granular sampler: a few seconds of any sound become slow clouds, sparkles, tape loops and swells, played from the keys and knobs. 14 factory sounds, your own samples (or recorded over USB), filter, delay, reverb and tape, and a companion web app for samples, presets and recording.

entries.description: Deep drum synth and sequencer that ports the Erica Synths LXR-02 and adds 22 more sound engines, generative sequencing, extensive randomization & modulation, live performance tricks, MIDI control of 300 parameters with Launchpad and Launch Control maps (see website), and 8-channel USB audio.

entries.name: ESTAMPIE
entries.author: Drew Robinson
entries.description: A groovebox for lively mediæval dance music: hurdy-gurdy, lutes, shawms and frame drums over drones, four tracks with 64-step sequencers, mediæval modes and temperaments, and velocity from the FM-1's own keys. Built on GHOULBOX and Felucca.

entries.name: ETCH
entries.author: Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks)
entries.description: Draw your own waveforms, morph between sounds, and bring them to life with modulation, evolving textures, and powerful effects. From warm analog-inspired tones to wild experimental soundscapes, ETCH puts sound design right at your fingertips.

entries.name: Evander's Music Box
entries.author: Michail Tsakiroglou
entries.description: A bard's instrument for LARP, medieval and high fantasy: recorder, hurdy-gurdy, harp and a tavern kit on four tracks, encounters and songs for the table. "Mother Melody hears thy song."

entries.name: everything-as-guitar
entries.author: xMagElonx
entries.description: Give any sound source a guitarist's playing semantics — in the browser. Strum any MIDI synth or imported DX7 voices; the M-VAVE FM-1 is the first tested target.

entries.name: EVIL GENIUS
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: A SID chip groovebox that talks. Six tracks of C64 SID voices and SAM speech, per-step sound locks, conditions, ratchets and MIDI FX, and a tower of eight retro effects with a send per track. Bluetooth MIDI and USB audio. A C64 game for a screen.

entries.name: Fernbedienung
entries.author: Kabelmaier
entries.description: Turns the FM-1 into the USB audio interface and the full controller for the iOS app Steckfeld SF1 on iPad and iPhone. The screen shows the same values as Steckfeld, so you can edit every module from the FM-1 without opening the programmer. The hacker crews get their own screens on the FM-1 too.

entries.name: ferrum
entries.author: MikeeTeevee
entries.description: The Interloper Ferrum is a firmware for the M-VAVE FM1 device. The software is an emulated tape looper. Choose from your box of cassettes, change the length and pitch of your loop. Play and dub sounds onto the loop and then shuttle it back and forth to create distorted and otherworldly sounds.

entries.name: fiendbox
entries.author: emilystgeist
entries.description: FIENDBOX: a demon synth firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1. A fork of GHOULBOX and Felucca, with ideas from JIANT FM.

entries.name: FiMba-1
entries.author: jadamsowers
entries.description: A physically modelled kalimba: tines laid out like the real one, thumb-roll chords, mbira patterns, a sound hole to cover, grains, tape and a plate reverb. Play it in the browser first.

entries.name: firmwave-mflasher-plus
entries.author: wellingtonsaam
entries.description: FirmWave (formerly M-Flasher+): firmware manager and custom firmware hub for the M-VAVE FM-1 and SMK-37

entries.name: FIZZ
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: A groovebox around one engine, ChoralRoot's FM TONE: six tracks, p-locks and preset sound locks, conditions, ratchets, chords, and MIDI FX for generative patterns and for reworking the ones you have. Bluetooth MIDI, and recording over USB audio.

entries.name: FLAT-20
entries.author: Brandon Matthews
entries.description: A circuit-level model of the Korg MS-20, built from its service manual's part values: KORG35 filters solved sample by sample, the transistor VCA, RC envelopes and a patch panel wired as real circuits. A companion macOS app shows the whole front panel live and patches cables by mouse.

entries.name: floop-studio
entries.author: eyfresco
entries.description: 4-track MIDI sequencer for FL Studio + live editor for the M-VAVE FM-1 with SLOOP. By @heyfresco

entries.name: flowstate-fm1
entries.author: zakariachowdhury
entries.description: Flowstate is an open-source FM-1 firmware that lets anyone make great-sounding music instantly with smart keys, musical guardrails, and four intuitive performance controls.

entries.name: Flyfish
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: One piece on the FM-1: Chopin's Etude in C major, Op. 10 No. 1, on a sampled Steinway D. Flyfish plays it and lets you shape it, practise it and move it.

entries.name: fm-1
entries.author: aviron3
entries.description: dub wise fm1 firmware

entries.name: FM-1 Chimera Vocal
entries.author: Shan-Sherif
entries.description: A singing human voice for the FM-1, ported from Jameson Hodge's CHIMERA. A simulated airway (lungs, vocal folds, throat, mouth, nose) sings words a syllable per key, or holds vowels you shape with the knobs. Write the words in the browser Studio and send them over USB.

entries.name: FM-1 Midi-Mania
entries.author: Shan-Sherif
entries.description: A rhythm game for the FM-1. Load songs from the browser Studio, turn any MIDI file into a song: your part's notes fall to the keys and you play KEYS, DRUMS, GUITAR or BASS while the FM-1 plays the rest on its synth engines. Every note judged, with combos and best scores.

entries.name: FM-1 SID
entries.author: Joakim Eriksson
entries.description: C64 music on the FM-1: a 6510 runs each tune's own code and reSID plays it, PSID and RSID. A GoatTracker 2 editor on the FM-1 itself with ten GT2 example songs, a SID synth with a sequencer and effects, and any .sid sent from the browser plays at once.

entries.name: FM-1 ZX
entries.author: Orest Kulik
entries.description: A ZX Spectrum 48K emulator: play Spectrum games with the FM-1's keys and knobs; pausing keeps your place, also after power-off. Five freely licensed games are built in, and a tool packs your own. Beeper music and effects can play on the FM synth, and it installs and updates over USB from the hub.

entries.name: FM-106

Four synths (one a Minimoog-style MUUG with 100 sounds, plus a light LITE synth), two drum kits, 12 drum pattern templates and a high-contrast VISUAL…

entries.name: KRIECHSTROM
entries.author: Grigorii Bezborodov
entries.description: Dark industrial and EBM on the FM-1. Six drum kits of its own, feedback that howls in tune, a sidechain pedal that pumps, crushes or talks through a vocoder, strings that ring with the mix, tape cut and glued back wrong, the GLCH engine, 185 sounds. Says its screen aloud.

entries.description: Alternative to the dark industrial and EBM firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, built on Felucca

entries.name: Kris Jangle
entries.author: w33tSnx
entries.description: Kris Jangle is a Christmas game for the FM-1: it plays the start of a carol and you replay it on the keys, building three notes per level up to the whole song. Four carols, three play modes from guided EASY to sound-only HARD, and Grump Mode on three misses.

entries.name: Kurzhaar, der Basshund
entries.author: JazzMasterT
entries.description: A monophonic analog-style bass synth with a step sequencer: two oscillators and a sub into a resonant ladder filter, two LFOs, drive and reverb, 16 presets. Basslines in your key and scale, 16 patterns, tight sync to a DAW's MIDI clock, and recording over USB audio.

entries.name: L/RRY
entries.author: OSCILL/R
entries.description: A stereo-field morphing synth. Two oscillators with eight models, a sub, noise and ring mod, two filters and two dirt stages, each with its own pan. Move the pans and the sound travels around you. A morph glides between two versions of every patch. Effects and a mod matrix. Best with headphones.

entries.name: LAMA-FLOW
entries.author: KONStudioPro
entries.description: LAMA FLOW — Custom vocal synthesizer firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 by The King Of Noise

entries.name: launchparty-fm1
entries.author: megagott
entries.description: Experimental FM-1 firmware for playable synth sounds and interactive Novation Launchpad Pro MK3 lightshows. Public edition with original procedural patterns.

entries.name: LCD-4
entries.author: devrvega
entries.description: LCD-4 for M-Vave FM-1

entries.name: ledger-4
entries.author: davidpryan
entries.description: M-VAVE FM-1 firmware: a tracker: song, chain, phrase, commands

entries.name: LOAF BREAKER
entries.author: FLEXOR
entries.description: A hardcore kick synthesizer powerhouse (gabber, terror, speedcore) and a breakbeat chopper (Based on CHOPPAH) : twenty kicks with distortion, sliced breaks, effects, drums, songs with drops, a BEGINNER mode, a DAW-like Studio on PC. The editor adds up to 8 breaks: yours or from a library of 90+.

entries.name: Loom FM-1
entries.author: Co-oscillator
entries.description: Four synth and sampler tracks and a drum track on 14 engines, among them wavetable, 6-op FM, tape scrub, granular and a slicer; a 64-step sequencer, a chord progression generator, macros and sidechain ducking.

entries.name: LOOM-8
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: A groovebox inspired by the OP-XY: eight tracks on nine engines, step tricks and locks, weave, a conductor and throws.

entries.name: LOOPHEADS
entries.author: Jaak St-Jaaques
entries.description: A four-tape looper and physical-modeling synth for the FM-1. Record and overdub independent note loops, reshape them with scales and live transpose, and let notes fade with Memory Leak. Each tape has its own sound, with shared delay and reverb.

entries.name: lowtide-fm1
entries.author: Cosmo-K-444
entries.description: A live groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: LSDJ Burrito
entries.author: Dreamy_bacon
entries.description: Little Sound Dj, the Game Boy tracker, on the FM-1: played from its keys and knobs, with per-channel filters, drive, lo-fi and an LFO, a shared echo, reverb and compressor, MIDI sync and colour themes. Bring your own LSDj: the project's web page adds it to this firmware on your computer.

entries.name: lunar-modulator
entries.author: ip2k
entries.description: Lunar Modulator — INTERGALACTIC MODULATION STATION. Open firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1: sound engines, a sequencer and a playable browser simulator. Preview: Lunar has not run on an FM-1 yet.

entries.name: LUXR
entries.author: HOLODECK AUDIOTOOLS
entries.description: An LXR-style drum machine: eight sounds, each a synth and a sample layer, with drive, delay, reverb, filter, compressor and limiter. 16 patterns of up to 64 steps, per-track speed, locks, conditional trigs, chains and song mode, MIDI clock and CC learn. Its samples are the Sonic Potions LXR's, non-commercial licence.

entries.name: Lyrebird
entries.author: StillMrEv
entries.description: Firmware for the FM-1 by M-Vave

entries.name: m-bootloader
entries.author: jvitkauskas
entries.description: Open-source bootloader for the M-VAVE FM-1 and SMK-37 Pro / Elite: checks firmware before starting it, recovery menu, download mode from the keys, firmware install and backup over USB MIDI. Plus M-Flasher's flash loader.

entries.name: M-PYRE
entries.author: History Of Sky
entries.description: A riffbox for rock and metal: real guitar, bass and drum samples, an amp engine with cabinet IRs, pedals and guitar effects, plus all of SLOOP's synth engines. Bend strings, play whammy, wah and palm mutes live, record on the 4-track and turn riffs into songs.

entries.name: M-Vance
entries.author: Kris (bk40-home)
entries.description: A JP-8000/8080-style virtual analog on eight voices: the JT-8000 engine ported to the FM-1, with Super Saw, the JP filter, multi-effects, delay, a plate reverb, an arpeggiator and 64 programs, every knob on the JP-8080's own MIDI CCs.

entries.name: M-Vsynth2
entries.author: Kris (bk40-home)
entries.description: Synth2, the open-source recreation of Synth1, on eight voices across both cores: two oscillators and a sub, five filters (LPDL among them), two LFOs, distortions and phasers, EQ, delay, chorus and Synth1's arpeggiator. It plays Synth1's .sy1 patches, with the Synth2 Factory bank built in and 1024…

entries.name: main_fm1-x0x
entries.author: nzbrian
entries.description: X0X: groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 (909, 808, two 303s with TB-3PO, breakbeat generator, song mode). A fork of Felucca.

entries.description: Hortator is an M-VAVE FM-1 custom firmware based on Felucca

entries.name: mainmenu-house-fm1

entries.name: Makohai
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: A generative groovebox in the style of early-90s PC tracker music. Six lanes (lead, arp, pad, bass, drums and sfx) play parts composed live in eighteen styles. You don't program steps, you mix styles: blend the next one in lane by lane, shape each lane with tracker effects and call the drop.

entries.name: MAKU
entries.author: okumurari
entries.description: An ambience machine for DJ interludes: switch it on and a random world in key plays, four parts, buttons that are verbs, and the worlds you like breed new ones. Clock follow. Play it in the browser first.

entries.name: mama-firmware
entries.author: f00br
entries.description: Exact FM-1 firmware packages verified on the MAMA bench, with their sources

entries.name: Manifold
entries.author: stets43
entries.description: Generative just-intonation firmware for the FM-1. Two layers of moving points wander a map of 41 scales and play the notes they pass; a rhythm without a grid drives four drums that follow the synth. Four knobs steer it, the keys play into it, and it can stream to Bluetooth speakers.

entries.name: Manta
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: Generative Latin grooves for the FM-1: a band on the clave in twelve styles, from salsa and mambo to bolero, bossa and tango, with sampled percussion, upright piano, brass, sax, violins and double bass. Lead the band with hits and a mambo, take the trumpet solo on the keys, or play and edit each…

entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: Matryoshka
entries.author: michael glaviano
entries.description: A modular synth for the FM-1: 30 factory patches built from nested modules, from classic polysynths to drum machines, each played with four knobs per page, plus a step sequencer with patterns and songs. Build your own patches in the browser editor and send them to the FM-1 over USB.

entries.name: MB-1
entries.author: Leonardo Lopez Chavira
entries.description: An aggressive monophonic virtual analog synth after the Arturia MiniBrute: Ultrasaw, PWM square, Metalizer triangle, sub and noise into a resonant multimode filter with Brute Factor. Two envelopes, LFO, arpeggiator, 64-step sequencer, five effects and 128 patch slots.

entries.name: MC-1
entries.author: dspaudio
entries.description: An original four-part groovebox with a 1990s workflow: three melodic parts and a 16-lane drum part, 128 melodic presets, eight drum kits, song arrangement, an arpeggiator and recorded knob moves.

entries.name: md-one
entries.author: d0pe1
entries.description: MD-1 - a Mutable-derived drone machine for the M-VAVE FM-1 (JieLi AC791N). Firmware, fixed-point DSP, and the measurements behind both.

entries.name: melisma-fm1
entries.author: joelio
entries.description: Melisma: a four-piece band you sit in with. Open-source firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 pocket synth. A Merlin Engines instrument.

entries.name: Melodee
entries.author: keremimo
entries.description: Total playing pleasure, far beyond Felucca: recording without quantize, microtonal scales, a Casio CZ-1, a bit-by-bit Dexed, scale modes made for an MPC Sample as its companion.

entries.description: Testing Ideas for custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.description: 8-Bit Memetek Firmware für fm1

entries.name: METRONOME
entries.author: Da-Wei Lee
entries.description: A stage metronome: 16 songs on the white keys, each with its own tempo, meter, pattern and sound, switched at the next bar. Tempo markings, meter presets up to 7/8, tap tempo. Web pages plan the setlist and play along over USB or Bluetooth: a conductor beating the meter, clicks from the computer.

entries.name: microton
entries.author: odshech
entries.description: microtonal fm1

entries.name: MIDIMON
entries.author: ignis32
entries.description: A MIDI monitor for USB, the TRS jack and Bluetooth (as device and host at once): hex or words, filters, stats. Its THRU routes, each filtered, make the FM-1 a Bluetooth MIDI dongle.

entries.name: Mighty Arcade
entries.author: Moby Pixel
entries.description: Mighty Arcade is 18 music-making games each built around a generative sequencer. Chess, Solitaire, Retro Games and more. The board, cards, balls and baddies all work together to make music while you play.

entries.name: Mighty Arp
entries.author: Moby Pixel
entries.description: Mighty Arp, from the creator of Mighty Synth Sampler, is a 4-op FM/subtractive synth built around a chance arpeggiator. Just hold a chord and let chance play the melody. 50 sounds plus a RANDOM mode that invents new ones, a 32-step sequencer, chords, effects and more.

entries.name: Miku-FM
entries.author: Michael Perry
entries.description: A singing songwriter: a pixel singer sings your songs in Japanese and English, consonants and all, over FM chords, bass and drums. Type words on the keys or in the web editor, play them a syllable per note, shape her voice and watch her dance. 10 song slots.

entries.name: MIN-1
entries.author: Reytian
entries.description: A tiny minimalist ensemble after Philip Glass: it starts playing when you switch on, you join whenever you like. In EASY mode every white key is a chord that fits. Four models, twenty pieces.

entries.name: Mini-Grain
entries.author: eldontyrellcorp
entries.description: A granular synth on your FM-1: two polyphonic granular parts plus a drone and a pad, each with a filter, two LFOs and its own step sequencer, into a shared ping-pong delay and plate reverb. Seven sample generators, your own samples sent over USB from a web page, 16 presets, and USB and TRS MIDI…

entries.name: Mini-Ju08
entries.author: Stephane Schmitz
entries.description: A Jupiter-8 style synthesizer for the M-VAVE FM-1 (both hardware versions). Eight voices in two parts (Whole, Dual, Split or 2-Part), two VCOs per voice with sync and cross mod, HPF and 12/24 dB ladder VCF, two ADSRs, LFO, arpeggiator and polyphonic portamento, 64 patches. Chorus and 17 MFX types…

entries.name: Mini-Tone
entries.author: Stéphane Schmitz
entries.description: Felucca with six tracks and new engines: SID, Braids' 48 models, a TB-303 and engines after Elektron's Analog Four, SY Chip and Digitone 2, a ping-pong delay and a new reverb. Built on Felucca 1.5.

entries.name: MNM-1
entries.author: Veff
entries.description: Six monophonic tracks of synth and FX machines, pages of eight knobs, a filter and a tape delay on every track, three LFOs a track, parameter locks and slides. Forked from Hortator, with sounds ported from MONO2K.

entries.name: modd
entries.author: DimmKirr
entries.description: Modd: A Modular Firmware for FM1

entries.name: MODELAR
entries.author: Hirakos
entries.description: A semi-modular drone synth played like a Kaoss Pad: four oscillators modulating each other through eight routings, and keys that move a cursor on an XY pad instead of playing notes: white keys are points, black keys gestures. ARP, a polymetric sequencer, a clock in Hz and eight generative environments.

entries.description: FM1 Rack 1.0: sound-design firmware design for the M-VAVE FM-1 (browser build)

entries.description: Film-music firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, based on Felucca

entries.name: MONK-1
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: Twelve singers, from Jerry the monk to Snider the punk, each in its own voice: MonkSynth's formant voices, played with velocity and pressure from the FM-1's own keys.

entries.name: MONO2K
entries.author: Iñigo Hernandez
entries.description: Six mono machines in the spirit of Elektron's Monomachine: FM, superwaves, wavetables, a SID, a voice and four drum synths, one per track. A 64-step sequencer with parameter locks, trig conditions and ratchets, a lofi bus, four demo parts and a web patch editor.

entries.name: Monohull
entries.author: Mark White
entries.description: A monosynth: one voice with analogue-modelled oscillators and five filters (ladder, diode ladder, OTA, Sallen-Key, state-variable), unison, chorus, delay and reverb, and 14 presets.

entries.description: Custom Firmware for M-vave FM1 implementing a Minimoog inspired synthesizer

entries.description: A tracker for you and your LLM — firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: moonglass-fm1
entries.author: killerboof
entries.description: Dream pop groovebox firmware for the M-Vave FM-1. 8 engines, 123 sounds, chord pads, CRT look. A GPL-3.0 fork of SLOOP.

entries.name: MOPE-1
entries.author: slothpallas
entries.description: A sad wavetable synth played by a pixel blob in a rainy room: its eyes are the filter, its mouth the envelope, its tears the delay. Gloomy beats with auto-bass, an arpeggiator, a pattern sequencer, twelve punch effects on the black keys, and presets of your own.

entries.name: MORPHEUS
entries.author: Ben Badio
entries.description: A pattern sequencer after Reason's Matrix: up to four channels of MIDI sequence data out, and a few voices built in to build the patterns with.

entries.name: MORSE
entries.author: Da-Wei Lee
entries.description: Learn and use Morse code: key on the piano keys (straight key or iambic paddles) and read what you sent, drill short and long presses, learn by sound with flash cards, hear endless practice, type letters and CW phrases. Keying goes out over USB or Bluetooth MIDI in the Vail format.

entries.name: MOSS-1
entries.author: Theo Wecker
entries.description: Ambient firmware: lofi chords, nature scenes and generative pads and bells, each with its own pixel picture. Play and the music follows: notes loop in an eight layer looper, each layer in its own voice. Build any chord progression or play whole chords live, program your own drums and a bass line…

entries.author: philippemann
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.author: MichaelAPerry
entries.description: Mario Paint-style music composer firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1: stamp characters on a staff with 31 Mario Paint sounds, layers, flats, triplets, swing, MIDI out and clock sync, and autosave. Built on fm1-base.

entries.author: Kiryl Dziamura
entries.description: Eight retro-game characters sing a line you type, a syllable a key, as a choir on chords, each with their own voice and a pixel face built from it. Record them into a multitrack loop that follows MIDI clock, or type and hear them speak. All synthesised, no samples.

entries.name: MYCELIUM
entries.author: Mandalars
entries.description: Forest, Psytrance, Goa and Hitech grooves, built on Felucca and SLOOP: original drums and icons and four factory songs. A test release: not yet fully tested on the device.

entries.name: n001se
entries.author: Saintpid
entries.description: FiMba-1: a physically modelled kalimba (thumb piano) firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, with mbira patterns, tape, grains and more. Built on Felucca, X0X and FoMni.

entries.name: NACHTFAHRT
entries.author: Cranky Man
entries.description: Generative 1970s Berlin School: two sequencers drift against each other over a drone, in eight endless pieces. Play a melody on the white keys and the lead answers it, takes it as its theme and grows new ideas from it.

entries.name: nano-freak-fm1
entries.author: Virusiinstaller
entries.description: Nano Freak: a uFreak-style synth for the M-Vave FM-1. Work in progress, built on FMini-1 and Felucca (GPL-3.0).

entries.name: nature-fm1
entries.author: Gorgonzola777
entries.description: NATURE: generative nature soundscapes (wind, sea, rain, fire, birds, thunder) with a pixel-art screen for the M-VAVE FM-1. A Felucca fork.

entries.name: Nauclerus
entries.author: Mr. Roboto
entries.description: An eight-track groovebox for the M-VAVE FM-1 with classic drum models, up to two 303-style ACID bass voices, 64-step patterns, ORB Remix and TB-3PO generation, Grids, motion recording, parameter locks, LFOs and delay.

entries.name: NCC – Novation Circuit Companion
entries.author: Fenderberg
entries.description: Turns the FM-1 into a two-part synth for the Novation Circuit Tracks: parts L and R follow MIDI 1 and 2 on split outputs, played from the Circuit's knobs. Twelve engines from DX7-style FM to Juno, CZ, acid and granular, 161 sounds, synced arp, drone and effects. Works with any MIDI keyboard too.

entries.name: NEON
entries.author: Neon Summers
entries.description: A synthwave groovebox: Juno pads, supersaw leads, pulsing basses and 80s drum machines. Pick a mood and one chord progression drives every track; WRITE drafts a part for each sound and VARY turns a bar into a 4-bar phrase. About 220 presets sorted by role.

entries.name: nerd-pocket
entries.author: jconde007
entries.description: Nerd Pocket: a virtual analog synth firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 (99 presets, arpeggiator, 16-step sequencer). Try it in the browser.

entries.name: Niagara Drift
entries.author: Evan Yerburgh
entries.description: A drone synth inspired by the SOMA Lyra-8, Moog Subharmonicon and Stylophone CPM DS-2. Two virtual-analog drones that breathe and drift on their own, with presets for instant ambient textures and full controls to push them into harsh, beating, self-oscillating sound.

entries.name: nightfall-fm1
entries.author: SylarPu-X
entries.description: NIGHTFALL: independent FM-1 synthesizer firmware and browser studio

entries.name: NIN-VAVE-Sloop-n-Slip
entries.author: Ch4pt3r23
entries.description: A live groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: nja-tack-fm1
entries.author: NjamesZ
entries.description: Nja TAK FM-1 Firmware

entries.name: No Man Sky FM
entries.author: Hericdk
entries.description: A space adventure while you make music, built on SLOOP 2.7.1: fly between planets with two knobs, land, mine, fight sentinels and warp between stars, every SLOOP screen floating over the game.

entries.name: no-kisses-just-hisses
entries.author: executive-time
entries.description: A live groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: noct-fm
entries.author: Joolo09
entries.description: NOCT FM — atmospheric pixel MIDI controller firmware for M-VAVE FM-1, with FL Studio and Ableton Live profiles. Engineering alpha.

entries.name: NOIZ DEMONS
entries.author: SPIKE the Percussionist
entries.description: Felucca with randomization as a ritual: every new sound summons one of 30 demons of the Ars Goetia, its sigil takes the screen and its rank decides how wild the sound gets.

entries.name: norilsk
entries.author: nzimas
entries.description: Norilsk: a firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 for ambient hellscapes, barren and grim atmospheres and noise -- everything drawn at random, wired at random, torn apart at will.

entries.name: NoteSorcery
entries.author: catacombius
entries.description: custom FM-1 Firmware with android / ableton integration

entries.name: numetal-skratchmaster-pro-fm1
entries.author: mhellar
entries.description: NU//METAL SKRATCHMASTER PRO: robot turntablist + nu metal band firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1. Tempo-synced LFO, 17 scratch techniques, mixer. Web MIDI installer. GPL-3, built on Dinghy/Felucca.

entries.name: OberVave
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: An 8-voice analog-style poly in the spirit of the classic American polys of 1979-84, now on four tracks: each its own sound, arp and sequence; a mixer with chorus, delay, plate reverb and drive sends, a master with DJ filter and compressor. Tracks start on the bar, patterns keep their sounds.

entries.name: obervave-multi
entries.author: HeyMoustache
entries.description: multitimbral obervave firmware for FM-1

entries.name: ObsSynth FM-1
entries.author: Orian Beltrame
entries.description: A four-voice synthesizer: two oscillators per voice, each STD (8 waves), SUPER (7 detuned saws, squares, triangles or sines), WT or GRAIN; a 12/24 dB multimode filter, two ADSRs, two LFOs, unison, delay, reverb and chorus. 16 factory presets, 16 of yours. Play it in the browser first.

entries.name: octo-vave
entries.author: amacias
entries.description: A collector and configurator for the MVAVE FM-1 community of firmware projects

entries.name: octodrone
entries.author: pjac1810
entries.description: OCTODRONE - synthé drone organique 8 voix pour M-VAVE FM-1 (firmware foma)

entries.name: oergelfm1
entries.author: manuelerdoes
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: OFFWORLD
entries.author: swtdr34mz
entries.description: A drone synth in the spirit of 80s sci-fi film scores: colossal brass, endless reverb, rain on neon. Macro knobs on sweetspots, DRONE, EPIC, a low split the melody follows, GLIDE, key pressure, CUES, MEMORY, and eight night-city scenes on the screen that light up with your notes.

entries.name: OG-Synth-source
entries.author: mikejohnsonbeats
entries.description: OG Synth (FM-1 firmware): source of the MPL-2.0 part. Site, installer, manual: https://ogsynth.cc

entries.name: Ombak
entries.author: Lunar Eclipse Forge
entries.description: A gamelan-inspired ensemble. Lead the core melody on the white keys and the ensemble answers: interlocking kotekan, reyong, kendang and gongs in measured Balinese and Javanese tunings, every note shimmering with ombak. Play the traditional forms, or slow it right down for meditation.

entries.name: ond
entries.author: mortenlein
entries.description: Clipper: an experimental synthesizer firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 (from SLOOP, based on Felucca)

entries.name: OP dream
entries.author: James
entries.description: An OP-1-style workflow for the FM-1: play, record and layer full songs on 6 tracks in real time, with no quantizing, plus a step sequencer. EDIT opens a Vital-style two-wave synth: design a sound, then send it to a track. Simple project and sound saving, on-screen tips. Based on Skiff.

entries.name: openmind
entries.author: kempnz
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: OpenVALive_FM-1
entries.author: Tom-Rfid
entries.description: OpenVALive for the M-VAVE FM-1: an open-source, live-first virtual analog synth and drum machine on four looping tracks. Emulator and web installer on the site.

entries.name: OPN-1
entries.author: putchdev
entries.description: The Sega Genesis / Mega Drive's Yamaha YM2612: six channels of 4-operator FM. Its web app takes patches from game music (VGM) and OPM files and streams VGM tunes to the FM-1 to play.

entries.name: OPQuencer
entries.author: andrixb
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: Opslix
entries.author: FroggyDenim
entries.description: FM1 Firmware to Mimic the Korg Opsix

entries.name: optimist
entries.author: w0ts
entries.description: Optimist: an open, modular firmware platform for the M-VAVE FM-1 (from SLOOP / Felucca)

entries.name: OrangeCat
entries.author: SeattleUser0
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: orbit
entries.author: bryanf2311
entries.description: ORBIT groovebox firmware for FM-1, based on SLOOP: sample tools, event tape editing, and OP-1-inspired screens.

entries.name: orbit

entries.description: ORBIT groovebox firmware for FM-1, based on SLOOP: sample tools, event tape editing, and OP-1-inspired screens.

entries.description: ORBIT groovebox firmware for FM-1, based on SLOOP: sample tools, event tape editing, and OP-1-inspired screens.
