entries.description: ORBIT groovebox firmware for FM-1, based on SLOOP: sample tools, event tape editing, and OP-1-inspired screens.

entries.name: orbit
entries.author: xerydian
entries.description: ORBIT groovebox firmware for FM-1, based on SLOOP: sample tools, event tape editing, and OP-1-inspired screens.

entries.name: ORBIT
entries.author: dspaudio
entries.description: A four-track groovebox: three synths and a drum machine in a colour-coded Synth, Drum, Event Tape and Mixer workflow, loops turned into songs, user macros, screens after the OP-1. Based on SLOOP.

entries.name: ORBITA
entries.author: Polaris Sound Lab
entries.description: A generative instrument for the FM-1. Three FM voices play interlocking rhythms while the screen draws their orbits live: Lissajous figures, polar roses, epicycles. Pick one of four scenes, turn density, phase and FM ratio, and it keeps evolving. Same notes and voices as the web version.

entries.name: organvave
entries.author: ruppert
entries.description: Custom Firmware for M-vave FM1 implementing an emulation of the Hammond B3 organ and Leslie speaker.

entries.name: OrGigs
entries.author: Bobo
entries.description: It's an organ. Three manuals with 84 free-running tone generators and no voice stealing, eight models from tonewheel and combo organs to pipe organs and free reeds, drawbars, percussion, rotary, drive, delay and reverb, 16 performance setups, three MIDI zones and Yamaha SEQTRAK control.

entries.name: ostinato
entries.author: androbi-com
entries.description: sequence generation device with FM-1 sloop backend

entries.name: outrigger
entries.author: chadthornton
entries.description: Brick-free FM1 firmware switching for FM1 from an ESP32

entries.name: p4-fm1-module
entries.author: imarkone
entries.description: Open-source ESP32-P4 synth module running FM-1 community firmware (Felucca) with USB-MIDI controller mapping

entries.name: Paisley
entries.author: DJSquintz
entries.description: Paisley – Custom Melodee firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: PaperLagoon
entries.author: hacha
entries.description: A generative ambient firmware. FM voices through a tape echo and a plate play by themselves in seven worlds that exist nowhere. You steer from outside: a key offers something to a hidden state, the knobs change the weather, and the music answers slowly.

entries.name: Patchwerk
entries.author: Matt Kuebrich
entries.description: A modular synth for the FM-1. With over 80 modules, including synth engines, samplers, filters, effects, sequencers, and generative tools, you can build, patch, and perform directly on the hardware.

entries.name: patricktronics
entries.author: gaumondp
entries.description: Generative Patricktronics layer on the Felucca FM-1 firmware (GPL-3.0 fork)

entries.name: Pelucco
entries.author: Gadlele
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1, a fork of Felucca

entries.name: Penumbra
entries.author: Lunar Eclipse Forge
entries.description: An ambient space-drone synth that plays itself until you do. Drone voices drift in and out, a far-off voice sings, and the sound glides from scene to scene as an eclipse crosses the screen. Every key is in tune, and loops follow each key change. A thick, slow drone, like the Solar 42.

entries.name: PERF-1
entries.author: deamonSLINKY
entries.description: A groovebox that plays itself while you steer it: 22 genres and 220 pieces that play like tracks, with builds, breakdowns and fills. Pad, bass, 303-style acid and DX7 pluck voices, 21 drum kits plus your own samples, an auto-DJ, effects on the keys and a web studio. Works on the newer FM-1s too.

entries.name: phreak-fm1
entries.author: dagnazty
entries.description: A live groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: pi32v2-llvm
entries.author: jvitkauskas
entries.description: LLVM with an experimental target for JieLi's pi32v2 CPU (AC791N: M-VAVE FM-1, SMK-37): clang and ld.lld for open firmware

entries.name: picovave
entries.author: acidsound
entries.description: PICO-8 (femto8) firmware for the M-Vave SMK-37 Pro, and the browser simulator built from the same sources

entries.name: PIGEON
entries.author: The Shrimp Blimp
entries.description: An old-school hip-hop and house sampler after the SP-404 and the PO-33: two song samples and a 16-pad kit, up to 32 chops a song, a 64-step sequencer, patterns and a song arrangement. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: PING OS-1
entries.author: PING AUDIO
entries.description: A rhythm synthesis groovebox: 69 synthesized drum and synth models (59 original), a deep sequencer with locks, ties, probability, cycles and ratchets, plus 23 chainable effects. A line generator writes in key; Autopilot evolves your tracks endlessly. Stutter, macros, snap-back controls, sampler…

entries.name: pinhead
entries.author: TruBitTech
entries.description: Pin Head – EMS Synthi AKS-inspired pin-matrix firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: pinktrombone-fm1
entries.author: stefanolofsson
entries.description: Pink Trombone voice synth as custom firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 (fm1-dock module)

entries.name: Piterfly
entries.author: Piotr Woźniak
entries.description: A groovebox OS for M-VAVE FM-1, built on SLOOP and Felucca: six synths plus two independent drum tracks, 24 patterns, 128 SONG positions and up to eight named songs in 352 KiB shared storage. Save/load from a list, delete and export songs to a computer. FUNB projects require new work; user-sample…

entries.name: PLAYA
entries.author: JFS
entries.description: A performance firmware built on Optimist: two synth layers on one keyboard (layer, split, blend or single), drums with a simple step sequencer, send effects, Bluetooth MIDI keyboards, and one easy to read screen with knobs 1-4 to edit all parameters. 5 engines, 32 drum kits, 135 presets.

entries.name: Plissken
entries.author: OscarDad
entries.description: A seven-part FM-1 soundtrack sketch: play Juno-style synth, piano, Pro One-style synth, guitar, bass and LM-1 drums, with CS-50 and CS-80-inspired sounds, chord modes and phrase recording.

entries.name: ploop-fm1
entries.author: scomp
entries.description: A live KSP groovebox  firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: Pocket Band
entries.author: elpabl0
entries.description: A band in your FM-1. Pick a spot on a map of 16 genre towns and it writes a four-piece sketch: drums, bass, keys and lead in one key. Re-roll parts, audition players, jam, morph, play punch-in effects, edit steps, save four slots. With a rhythm game played over your own drum part.

entries.name: Pocket GammaWave
entries.author: ShadowTune (GammaWave Audio)
entries.description: The companion to the GammaWave desktop synth: four industrial distortions, vowel and scream filters, an FFT spectrogram, a four-track tape deck screen and a song generator with 49 genres, trap and drill too.

entries.name: Pocket-Onyx
entries.author: 28spawn
entries.description: Custom open-source firmware (Onyx) for M-VAVE / Donner Pocket Amp

entries.name: Polly
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: A pocket arranger after the QY70: pick a style, play three keys for a chord and a band of eight follows, songs from sections, General MIDI sounds from Sonivox EAS, and a General MIDI module over MIDI in.

entries.name: poly5
entries.author: questron5000
entries.description: POLY5: five synths in one for the M-VAVE FM-1. Round robin, random, lofi tape. Open firmware on Dinghy.

entries.name: pro-fm-78
entries.author: hamperj
entries.description: PRO-FM-78: a vintage polysynth for the FM-1, with a chord generator, arpeggiator and loop recorder (fm1-dock module and firmware)

entries.name: PROPHET-67
entries.author: swtdr34mz
entries.description: A 7-voice analogue-style polysynth in the manner of the Sequential Prophet-6: two oscillators with continuously variable shape, hard sync and a sub-octave, a high-pass into a self-oscillating 4-pole low-pass, the classic POLY MOD, VINTAGE voice character (SELECT), VOICE SPREAD (ALGORITHM)…

entries.name: Prysm
entries.author: NicholasPratt
entries.description: Synth-module firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, built on Dinghy / Felucca (GPL-3.0)

entries.name: PT/FM
entries.author: hitosu
entries.description: A ProTracker-style pocket studio: DX7 FM, JUNO-106, TB-303, chip, sampler and FUSION instruments side by side, 16 voices on both cores, a loop station, a two-deck DJ mode, punch-in effects and over 500 built-in instruments.

entries.name: PULHRA
entries.author: 646timur-cell
entries.description: A minimal Elektron-style groovebox: four tracks, patterns in banks A to E, parameter locks, trig conditions, chains, an arpeggiator per track and per-pattern kits on the MONOFM sound core. A hard fork of Felucca.

entries.name: PurpleMonkey
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: A first instrument for toddlers: random key bashing and knob turning are rewarded with dancing animated pets and little musical sequences. Press a key, any key.

entries.name: PurpleMonkeyLiteFM1
entries.author: tashvit
entries.description: MVave FM-1 Firmware for babies

entries.name: quadro-fm1
entries.author: matttallison
entries.description: Arp Quatdra Synthesizer Firmware for the M-Vave FM1

entries.name: Quantum GammaWave
entries.author: Guille Lauría
entries.description: A six-track groovebox for the M-VAVE FM-1: nine engines and 273 sounds (analog, six-operator FM, wavetable, digital drums), a 64-step sequencer with probability and ratchets, song mode, scales and chords, a mod matrix and three FX buses, plus a browser emulator and a web editor.

entries.name: Quartet
entries.author: MammothCheese
entries.description: A pedal-driven groovebox for musicians: lead, pads, bass and drums, each through its own board of 30 effect pedals. 72 sounds, 23 kits, step and live recording, and a song sequencer.

entries.name: QUARTZ
entries.author: f0nski
entries.description: A four-track groovebox: Plaits' 24 models, a 16-pad kit, a step sequencer with p-locks and trig conditions, nine generative sources you can PRINT into steps (Game of Life, chords, Tonnetz, orbits, bytebeat, an improviser...), live transposition, punch-in effects, four projects and a scene per page.

entries.name: quasar
entries.author: nzimas
entries.description: Quasar: a firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 for experimental IDM, after the SOMA Pulsar-23, with an audio engine written from scratch.

entries.name: Quorum
entries.author: zeptosecond-dsp
entries.description: A generative additive synthesizer for the M-Vave FM1. Code by Claude, creative direction by Zeptosecond DSP

entries.name: Rainbow Mode
entries.author: joshbartlettband-web
entries.description: A music toy for little children: 63 cartoon friends, every key in tune, chords, strumming, songs to follow and an ear game, notes on a staff, a volume cap for small ears.

entries.name: RAKT
entries.author: Chase DeAnda
entries.description: Pick a style and generate a band in one press. Chords, bass, drums and melody stay in sync and play off each other. In GLO Live, use the keys to solo parts, cue fills and drops, and play effects over the groove.

entries.name: RAMBEAVER
entries.author: Trust This Mechanism
entries.description: A side-scrolling action game with synthesized music, sound effects and character voices. Defend the dam, ride through robot city, fly to the data center and stop Mother.

entries.name: ravefm2
entries.author: MorrisKraken
entries.description: RAVE FM 2 - early hardcore groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: Ravel
entries.author: De-Pattern
entries.description: An eight-track groovebox for sound design: thirteen synth engines, struck percussion and 33 drum machines after the Machinedrum, on an influence grid where any track can trigger, excite or modulate any other.

entries.name: Ravel-FM1
entries.author: Kenneth-Rakentine
entries.description: Ravel is a custom firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 that turns the FM-1 into a pocket groovebox for sound design. It has 8 tracks that synthesize, catch what they play onto a shared tape, cut it up & rebuild it with tracks that can play, excite, and reshape one another

entries.name: Ravel_FM1
entries.author: birkmann
entries.description: Ravel is a custom firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 that turns the FM-1 into a pocket groovebox for sound design. It has 8 tracks that synthesize, catch what they play onto a shared tape, cut it up & rebuild it with tracks that can play, excite, and reshape one another

entries.name: RDPNO
entries.author: R-Jeb
entries.description: Roland's SA pianos (MKS-20, Rhodes MK-80): a cycle-exact emulation of their CPU-B board, after rdpiano. No Roland data inside: you load your own ROM dumps from the web page. The MKS-20's EQ, chorus (Space-D or BBD) and tremolo, up to 8 notes, a live web editor.

entries.name: regent-4
entries.author: davidpryan
entries.description: M-VAVE FM-1 firmware: play chords; four parts follow them

entries.name: reggae-os
entries.author: KemstheSage
entries.description: REGGAE-OS: hardware-first reggae synthesizer firmware for M-VAVE FM-1, based on Felucca

entries.name: RemoteFM1
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: A firmware for your firmwares when using the app or a high quality 24bit DX7 rompler with 16 user carts and MIDI Controller when using the FM-1 by itself. BLE and USB supported!

entries.name: ReplicantFM1
entries.author: DanimanX
entries.description: Hard techno firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 — custom GPL-3.0 firmware (fork of Felucca) with kick/drum/bass/hi-hat and acid sounds

entries.name: retrodash
entries.author: nasonliu
entries.description: Pixel-art rhythm-game firmware for M-VAVE FM-1 with SPC sample playback and per-song art projects

entries.name: ReVo
entries.author: gggguto
entries.description: ReVo — Generative Soundscapes. Bioma and Atolls, experimental firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1.

entries.name: RhinoTiger
entries.author: hacha
entries.description: A generative psytrance firmware, from dark psy to hi-tech. A kick, a rolling FM bass, percussion, a repeating line and an atmosphere play by themselves in eight worlds. Steer with four macro knobs and mutes; throw one-shot sounds or play sixteen effects on the keys. AUTO PLAY plays a whole set.

entries.name: Rhythmer
entries.author: Jazzy Rhythmer
entries.description: A hands-on groovebox firmware for the FM-1. Shape sounds, build patterns, and find your own groove. Up to six assignable tracks, sound design, sequencing and performance. Free and open source, built on JIANT and reworked by Jazzy Rhythmer.

entries.name: RHYTM-SEC-1
entries.author: James Hampshire
entries.description: Expressive rhythm section ideas fast. Pick one of 19 styles and it draws patterns from that genre's feel, which keep evolving as you play, over a bass line in your key. Breaks, builds and fills on a button, a DJ filter, MIDI clock sync and USB audio stems for your DAW.

entries.name: riddim-roots-fm1
entries.author: tskorbenko
entries.description: RIDDIM ROOTS — generative reggae/dub band firmware for M-VAVE FM-1 (FM1 Open SDK)

entries.name: riffsmith-fm1
entries.author: pedronogueiranunes
entries.description: Riffsmith for the M-VAVE FM-1: guitar firmware (fork of M-PYRE by History Of Sky) with a synthesised GUITAR engine, indie/metal/reggae amps and presets

entries.name: rift-fw
entries.author: Vaayaa
entries.description: RIFT firmware for FM-1

entries.name: roland
entries.author: andiogenes
entries.description: Drum-only firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, built on Felucca (GPL-3.0-only)

entries.name: RudimentSeq-FM1
entries.author: RudimentSeq
entries.description: RudimentSeq for the M-VAVE FM-1: a Felucca fork that plays drum rudiments. GPL-3.0.

entries.name: Ruido
entries.author: Miguel Hernández Domenech
entries.description: Ruido is a 4-oscillator drone and noise synthesizer firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 with coupled voices, dual resonant filters, scene morphing, and pressure-sensitive performance effects. It is created as a dry stereo sound source for external pedals and modular setups.

entries.name: RUPTURE
entries.author: Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks)
entries.description: A monophonic bass synth on Cycle Exchange Synthesis: two sub-oscillators, a ladder filter, Channel EQ, eight effects from MOSFET drive to octave fuzz, a step sequencer up to 128 steps and an arpeggiator.

entries.name: S1Vave
entries.author: Andrew GG
entries.description: An 8-voice virtual analog tweak synth: authentic 4-pole resonant filter, dual sub-oscillator, ADSR envelopes, 64-step sequencer, and hands-on live performance controls.

entries.name: saadet
entries.author: keremimo
entries.description: Single-part synthesizer firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, with Bluetooth MIDI and native 24-bit audio

entries.name: Saibertin-S-FM
entries.author: Qubestar
entries.description: Experimental MIDI controller and hardware sequencer firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: SAMSARA
entries.author: Tomorrow's Man
entries.description: A slow generative ambient piece that plays itself for hours and never repeats: a choir pad, soft bells, a gliding bass and a rare low ground drift through harmonies and colours like weather. Four pieces, four knobs to tend it (Mood, Density, Drift, Space). A fork of AMB-1.

entries.name: sardab
entries.author: jrdntnnr
entries.description: Dungeon synth firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, turned toward the desert: maqam tuning, Arabic rhythm, oud and ney, stone rooms. GHOULBOX on Felucca 1.6, with code from SLOOP, JIANT and Melodee.

entries.name: Sardine
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: Live club mixing for the FM-1: four layers (lead, chord, bass, drums) that play by themselves in 20 styles while you ride them live. Blend one style into the next, build with intros and break-build-drop arcs, edit steps or play a layer by hand. All synthesised but the piano.

entries.name: SATIE-1
entries.author: OCKM Studio
entries.description: Erik. Evolved. Ten Satie pieces become an evolving electronic soundtrack in five moods. Choose a tune, set the pace and blend Solo, Duet or Trio. Shape each instrument, add vinyl colour and synced delay, or simply let it play. GLO opens the quick guide.

entries.name: Scintilla
entries.author: Joakim Eriksson
entries.description: The 1981 Elka Synthex on the FM-1: all 80 factory sounds, Paul Wiffen's laser harp among them, checked sample by sample against the original. Two layers of 8 voices (single, split, double), poly, mono or unison, chorus and reverb, and the four knobs edit what is on the screen.

entries.name: VESPER
entries.author: Fat Cat Studios
entries.description: An ambient worship synth. Each scene layers four lush voices in any major key around a crystal orbit home screen: pads, plucks, piano and swells. Shape them with drive, tone, granular clouds, shimmer, reverb and delay, then play live over the scene or record into it.

entries.name: VIBE FM Link
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: Play the VIBE FM VST plugin with your FM-1. Install this and the FM-1 is the controller: the keys play, KNOB 1-4 and every button do in the plugin what they do on the FM-1 – SLOOP, Felucca, OberVave and the other converted firmwares feel like home, in your DAW, in the Web Player and on the VIBE FM. The sound comes from the plugin, not the FM-1. Plain MIDI: any synth or DAW can learn it too.

entries.name: Viber
entries.author: Anto
entries.description: Six-track groovebox for the FM-1: synths and drums, a wavetable engine, clips on two pages, Ableton-style knobs and a master VU meter. Based on Skiff and Felucca.

entries.name: virgo-fm1
entries.author: mongio
entries.description: Mario Texture's VIRGO – gravitational-wave synth firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: virtuox-mvave-fm1
entries.author: telespial
entries.description: VirtuoX — The Interactive Piano Engine for M-VAVE FM-1. DX7 FM synth, MIDI piano coach, music theory, scales, chords, falling-note lessons, effects and sequencer. Browser demo and open-source firmware development.

entries.name: vizz-firmware
entries.author: tumult2k4
entries.description: Vizz: Skiff fork for the M-VAVE FM-1 (SEQ MIDI OUT, mute/solo CC 103)

entries.name: VNL-1
entries.author: pianomansam
entries.description: A generative lo-fi DJ groovebox: endless, complete songs built with music theory, each with its own key, chords, layout and six-part band (drums, bass, accompaniment, lead, pad, texture). Let it play, or shape the songs live.

entries.name: Volna
entries.author: M_Bougrimoff
entries.description: A wavetable synth for the FM-1 with three oscillators per voice, two filters, a modulation matrix, two effects slots and a step arpeggiator with a pattern per patch.

entries.name: VostockFM-1
entries.author: g0rst
entries.description: Custom Firmware for m-vave FM-1 and SMK-37

entries.name: WAMMY
entries.author: zshelby
entries.description: A guitar firmware for the FM-1

entries.name: Wanderer
entries.author: Nicholas James / Low Vision Music
entries.description: Wanderer 1.4: author-tested synth for low-vision musicians. Protect an Anchor, evolve two layers, play 100 sounds, eight Scatter modes and a 13-pattern arp. Adaptive/steady Zoom, clear knob controls, adjustable display hold and optional audio cues.

entries.name: watchy-cart
entries.author: Kevin66hz
entries.description: Watchy v3 as a firmware cartridge for the M-VAVE FM-1 (test version)

entries.name: WaveLoop FM-1
entries.author: ELI7VH
entries.description: Felucca played from an Arturia MiniLab 3: track faders, a DJ filter, momentary effect pads; 32 patches a bank, 12 evolving songs, revoiced 808 and CR78 kits.

entries.name: Wild
entries.author: abcdaniel
entries.description: Wild firmware for M-Vave FM1, samma som n001se

entries.name: Wild
entries.author: Saintpid
entries.description: Wild firmware for M-Vave FM1

entries.name: winampFM Synth
entries.author: Hericdk
entries.description: Winamp 2.x on the FM-1, built on SLOOP: your sounds as a playlist, four tracks you record as loops, effects on sliders and a visualizer made of lines. The real firmware plays in a 3D simulator first.

entries.name: Windjammer
entries.author: osleg
entries.description: Open companion controller firmware and protocol for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: witchbox
entries.author: davidpryan
entries.description: WitchBox: a six-track 2-step / melodic dubstep groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: wndrfm1
entries.author: rodneff
entries.description: Minimal sound exploration firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, based on Felucca.

entries.name: wolfware
entries.author: severak
entries.description: Timbre Wolf firmware for MVawe FM1. Placeholder repository as I don't have FM1 yet (it's in transit).

entries.name: WT-1

entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: wt2-fm1-firmware
entries.author: DedrichVonDorn
entries.description: WT-2: wavetable synth firmware for the M-Vave FM-1 (GPL-3.0)

entries.name: wt_lab
entries.author: jsmith13
entries.description: Wavetable synthesis firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, sibling of FM Lab.

entries.name: wulzie
entries.author: woolydawg5
entries.description: Custom GPL-3.0 firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1: a bass-heavy, space-bending groovebox. In planning, nothing to flash yet.

entries.name: X0X
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: A groovebox: 909 and 808 drums, two 303s with TB-3PO, a breakbeat generator and song mode.

entries.name: X0X-HARDER
entries.author: deluded
entries.description: X0X-HARDER: Custom M-VAVE FM-1 groovebox firmware with ORB Remix, TB-303, 808/909, Alpha Juno, Grids, Morph and USB project backup.

entries.name: X0X-RMX
entries.author: Mr-Roboto (Oliver)
entries.description: X0X remixed after The Orb: banks and patterns reordered live per voice, Grids MAP and EUCLID drum generation, an extended TB-3PO with 22 scales and a morphing 303 waveform. Built on X0X.

entries.name: x0z-fm1
entries.author: zambari
entries.description: z-flavoured fork of X0X: groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 (909, 808, two 303s with TB-3PO, breakbeat generator, song mode).

entries.name: XANOISE
entries.author: Xanacognition
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: XENOLITH
entries.author: Unit_v743
entries.description: An experimental mono-track FM cell synthesizer with programmable oscillator routing, modulation, sequencing, a vintage circuit-derived filter, VCA, wavefolding, digital fidelity reduction and reverb. A load engine models physical voltage sag and progressively shrinks resource usage under stress.

entries.name: XMOD
entries.author: Kot Morderca
entries.description: A MOD / XM tracker, sampler and groovebox: play, write and save FastTracker 2 and ProTracker songs on the FM-1, up to 32 channels, with a ProTracker mode for MODs and a song manager in the browser for moving songs to and from the computer.

entries.name: YamahaDX7_to_FM-1
entries.author: s0fx2
entries.description: Split Yamaha DX7 32-voice bank (.syx) to M-VAVE FM-1's third-party firmware can import.

entries.name: yanfei
entries.author: izumoe
entries.description: Custom firmware for M-VAVE FM-1

entries.name: Yehnah
entries.author: Mello-D
entries.description: Six-track groovebox firmware with 25 synthesis engines, 800+ presets and no samples. Chord layouts you play with one thumb, a 64-step sequencer, idea generators, songs with arrangement, SWARM, TRACE and XYZ sound-morphing pads, a browser editor and emulator.

entries.name: ZEN-1
entries.author: aceyprime
entries.description: Ambient as a living window: cherry petals on a river, koi in a pond, fireflies under a real moon, and every movement a note. Set it down and let it play; the keys play along, the knobs shape the scene.

entries.name: ZENITH-1
entries.author: Polystellarflow
entries.description: Generative ambient that plays itself, and you can steer it: swap the sounds of the pads, bells, bass, beats, lead and air, guide where it goes, or let it wander through 8 worlds. 27 melodic effects, strum or play the lead on the keys. Works on older and newer FM-1s.

entries.name: zombie-fm1-web
entries.author: Joolo09
entries.description: Zombie Core for M-VAVE FM-1 — Afterglow web editor and USB MIDI firmware installer, RU / EN.

entries.name: zp12
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: A 12-bit sampler after the E-mu SP-1200: sample on the FM-1 itself (a computer or phone plays into it over USB) or in the browser (mic, line-in or a file), and it plays on its own. Gritty and unsmoothed, with loops and songs.
